items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then there was Truehard and Don Kirpatrick.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. First jazz flutist. He was the first or whatever. The first guy I ever heard play jazz on a flute like that.
And then there was Truehard and Don Kirpatrick.
Don Kirpatrick was a piano player and arranger. Great arranger.
